title: El Mercurio interview: Investment Surprise May Delay Recovery, RPM Inflation-Risk Message Stands
source: el_mercurio (press interview, Q&A, by Jessica Marticorena)
summary: In a long El Mercurio Q&A after the Q3 GDP drop and the IEF, Costa spends most of the time on activity: Q3 surprised on mining and on investment, which keeps falling with no clear signs of a turn, so the recovery 'may take somewhat longer', with the full reassessment left to the December IPoM. On inflation she does not soften the October RPM: she restates that its main message was the relevant rise in inflation risks, with near-term projections up significantly, and treats the fuel-price freeze as conditional on oil (pass-through later if international prices stay above the cap). On the peso above 1,000 she sees moves driven by copper and the global dollar, calls it a necessary adjustment, rules out intervention and deflects Quiroz's remarks on a firmer stance and on the rate differential, giving no rate path. This is her first entry in the base; it reads as a hold that keeps the October hawkish guidance intact despite weaker activity, close to Céspedes (17/11) and firmer than Naudon (19/11), though the interview format gives no explicit next step.

key_quotes.quote: El principal mensaje de la última Reunión de Política Monetaria fue el relevante aumento de los riesgos para la inflación, destacando que las proyecciones para los próximos meses aumentaban significativamente.
key_quotes.context: Asked whether the fuel freeze lets inflation close the year below the 4.3% IPoM estimate

key_quotes.quote: Vemos que la inversión siguió más débil de lo esperado en el tercer trimestre, y ese es un elemento importante que está presente
key_quotes.context: On the Q3 GDP contraction; non-mining activity in line with the September IPoM

key_quotes.quote: Puede tardar algo más la recuperación, aunque no la esperábamos en el tercer trimestre, pero sí esperábamos una recuperación hacia 2027.
key_quotes.context: On whether the weakness may last longer than expected

key_quotes.quote: Los mercados están funcionando normalmente y el dólar está respondiendo a las condiciones globales
key_quotes.context: Asked whether the BCCh will intervene with the dollar above 1,000 pesos
